findings.title: Timer-started Pre-Vote round survives leader establishment and makes the new leader re-elect
findings.summary: With enable_pre_vote, a Candidate whose real election outlives its election timeout starts a Pre-Vote round (handle_tick_election skips only Leaders). When the real quorum arrives, establish_leader takes only `candidate`; become_leader does not clear `pre_candidate`. The round's later quorum passes the runtime gate and handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() from the established Leader, bumping the term while the old Leader object stays (debug_assert in try_leader_handler fires; in release the leader abandons leadership and the term inflates).

findings.title: Completed Pre-Vote round elects a node that left the voters; its self-grant panics RaftCore
findings.summary: handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() on a quorum of the round's frozen membership without the is_voter check every old elect() caller performs. If the node removed itself from the voters (kept as learner) while the round was in flight, do_elect builds a candidate over voters that exclude it; the runtime's local self-grant after save_vote reaches Candidate::grant_by, whose expect("target not in quorum set") panics RaftCore.

findings.title: Repeated Pre-Vote round at the same hypothetical vote counts a delayed grant from a removed node; RaftCore panics
findings.summary: Pre-Vote rounds started at an unchanged vote all probe the same (term+1, self); the runtime gate correlates PreVoteResponse notifications by leader id only. After a membership change removes a node, a second round accepts that node's delayed grant from the first round, and grant_by panics because the node is not in the new round's quorum set.
